description: Use this when a user describes a business funding need and wants to know which types of business finance could fit. Takes a description of the business and the need, and returns up to four matching facility types (for example invoice finance, asset based lending, a term loan, bridging or development finance), why each fits, what lenders usually look at, documents to prepare and indicative terms as published on growthbusinessfinance.com. If the user asks for a facility type by name, pass it in interested_in so it is shown first. The order of the results is not a ranking. Results are general information from Growth Business Finance, a UK commercial finance broker: not advice and not an offer of finance.

amount_band.description: Roughly how much funding is needed.

assets.description: Assets the business holds that could support lending. Use ['none'] if none.

business_description.description: What the business does, in a sentence or two.

interested_in.description: Facility types the user has asked for by name, if any (for example cash_flow_term_loan when they ask for a cash flow loan). They are shown first.

profitable.description: Whether the business is currently profitable.

sector.description: The business's sector, for example manufacturing or recruitment.

trading_years.description: Years the business has been trading, or null if unknown.

uk_based.description: True if the business is based in the UK.

name: find_facility_types
title: Find business finance facility types
